description.narrative: Sveriges stöd till MAPP/OAS syftar till att främja fredsbyggande i de regioner i Colombia som är mest påverkade av den väpnade konflikten. Genom ledsagning och stöd till dialog- och förhandlingsprocesser bidrar stödet till genomförandet av fredsavtalet mellan Colombias regering och olika väpnade grupper. Insatsen stärker statens närvaro, det civila samhällets roll och lokalsamhällens inflytande i frågor som rör fred, rättvisa, jämställdhet och territoriell utveckling. Stödet ligger i linje med Sveriges strategi för utvecklingssamarbete med Colombia samt det nya mandatet för MAPP/OAS 2025–2027.

Sweden’s support to MAPP/OAS aims to promote peacebuilding in the regions of Colombia most affected by the armed conflict. Through accompaniment and support to dialogue and negotiation processes, the Swedish support contributes to the implementation of the peace agreement between the Colombian government and various armed groups. The initiative strengthens state presence, the role of civil society, and local communities’ influence in issues related to peace, justice, gender equality, and territorial development. The support is in line with Sweden’s development cooperation strategy with Colombia and the new MAPP/OAS mandate for 2025–2027.

The overall objective of the MAPP/OAS (OAS Peace Mission in Colombia) is to support peace-building in Colombia through monitoring, accompaniment, technical assistance and capacity building, mainly in the regions and with the communities most affected by the internal armed conflict.
MAPP/OAS aims to strengthen the peace-building processes in the regions most affected by the internal armed conflict, criminality and inequalities through the following:
1. Accompany and support the dialogue, negotiation and endorsement processes, and the implementation of the agreements reached between the Colombian government and the different armed groups with a national or local presence, within the frame of the Total Peace Law.
2. Strengthen the process through which the Colombian state makes decisions to address situations of the armed conflict and social unrest; its impact on the communities; and the transformations of the dynamics of violence.
3. Strengthen the decision-making process of the Colombian state, the cooperation between the state and civil society, and the capacity of social actors to influence the formulation of public policies directed to victims, peace, gender, protection of the environment, territorial transformation and development.
